description: Unit test script for the 'Executive' class and 'ScriptError' class in the webkitpy.common.system.executive module, including tests for command execution, process management, and Unicode handling.

classes.name: ScriptErrorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ScriptError class, testing message formatting with output and tuple inputs.

classes.name: ExecutiveTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the Executive class, covering command execution, process management, Unicode handling, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_message_with_output
methods.description: Tests the message_with_output method of ScriptError with various inputs.

methods.name: test_message_with_tuple
methods.description: Tests the message_with_output method with a tuple command input.

methods.name: test_run_command_with_bad_command
methods.description: Ensures run_command raises OSError for invalid commands.

methods.name: test_run_command_args_type
methods.description: Checks that run_command asserts on non-string, non-tuple arguments.

methods.name: test_auto_stringify_args
methods.description: Verifies that command arguments are correctly stringified.

methods.name: test_popen_args
methods.description: Tests that explicit args parameter in popen works without error.

methods.name: test_run_command_with_unicode
methods.description: Validates Unicode input/output handling in run_command.

methods.name: test_kill_process
methods.description: Tests killing a process and silent failure on second kill.

methods.name: test_timeout_exceeded
methods.description: Checks that a timeout causes ScriptError.

methods.name: test_timeout_exceeded_exit_code
methods.description: Verifies non-zero exit code on timeout.

methods.name: test_timeout_satisfied
methods.description: Ensures commands complete when timeout is sufficient.

methods.name: test_check_running_pid
methods.description: Tests checking if a PID is active.

methods.name: test_running_pids
methods.description: Verifies current process PID is in the list of running PIDs.

methods.name: test_run_in_parallel_assert_nonempty
methods.description: Checks that run_in_parallel asserts on empty input list.
